parts.title: Part 1: Read Aloud
parts.instructions: You will read two texts aloud. You have 45 seconds to prepare and 45 seconds to read each text.
questions: Welcome to the annual technology conference. Today's keynote speaker, Dr. Sarah Mitchell, will present her research on artificial intelligence in healthcare. The presentation will begin in the main auditorium at 10:00 AM. Please find your seats and silence your mobile devices.

Attention passengers: The 3:45 PM express train to Boston has been delayed by approximately 20 minutes due to track maintenance. We apologize for the inconvenience. Updated departure time is 4:05 PM from Platform 3. Please check the departure board for further updates.

parts.title: Part 2: Describe a Photo
parts.instructions: You will describe two photographs. You have 45 seconds to prepare and 45 seconds to speak for each photo.
questions: Describe this photo: A busy office environment where several employees are working at computers. One person is standing at a whiteboard giving a presentation to colleagues seated around a table.
Describe this photo: An outdoor market with colorful fruit and vegetable stalls. A vendor is handing a bag of apples to a customer while other shoppers browse the displays.

parts.title: Part 3: Respond to Questions
parts.instructions: You will answer three questions about a topic. You have 5 seconds to prepare and 15-30 seconds to respond to each.
questions: Imagine you are calling a restaurant to make a reservation. The host asks: 'How many people are in your party?'
The host then asks: 'What time would you like to dine with us this evening?'
Finally, the host asks: 'Do you have any special dietary requirements we should know about?'

parts.title: Part 4: Respond Using Information
parts.instructions: You will be given information to read. Then answer three questions using that information. You have 30 seconds to read, then 15 seconds to respond to each question.
questions: Information: The City Library offers free computer classes every Saturday. Beginner classes run from 9 AM to 11 AM. Intermediate classes are from 1 PM to 3 PM. Registration is required and can be done online or in person. Class size is limited to 15 students. Question: What time do the beginner computer classes start?
Using the same information: How can someone register for the classes?
Using the same information: What is the maximum number of students per class?

questions: Some people prefer to work independently, while others prefer to work in a team. Which do you prefer and why? Include specific reasons and examples to support your opinion.
